top_choice_rationale: P002 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) is a mature, independently reproduced result at fractional uncertainties near 1e-18, with a specific mechanism (magic-wavelength Lamb-Dicke lattice cancelling the trap light shift) distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-quantum-system prizes, and a complete two-name allocation with no decisive contributor omitted. P001 (Kane, Mele, Molenkamp) is a strong second, but the HgTe proposal by Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang cannot be credited under the three-name limit and the 2016 topological-phase prize leaves a precedent question; it still ranks well above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; field proximity to atomic physics and precision measurement only, with no documented tie to Katori or Ye
